title: The Little Prince — a simple retelling
note: SIMPLIFIED RETELLING, not the original book. These 12 short chapters retell the story in simple A2 English, written for this app. They do NOT reproduce Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's text or the Katherine Woods English translation. The original book is still under copyright in the United States (first published 1943); the full original text is deliberately NOT bundled here. See README.md / DATA_SOURCES.md for where to read the real book lawfully.

sentences.en: A pilot flies a small plane over the desert.
sentences.zh: 一位飞行员驾驶着一架小飞机飞越沙漠。

sentences.en: One day, the engine stops.
sentences.zh: 有一天，发动机停了。

sentences.en: The plane falls down onto the sand.
sentences.zh: 飞机落到了沙子上。

sentences.en: The pilot is alone.
sentences.zh: 飞行员一个人待着。

sentences.en: He has water for only eight days.
sentences.zh: 他只有八天的水。

sentences.en: He must fix the plane, or he will die.
sentences.zh: 他必须修好飞机，不然就会死。

sentences.en: At night, he looks at the stars.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他看着星星。

sentences.en: The desert is very quiet.
sentences.zh: 沙漠非常安静。

sentences.en: On the second morning, something strange happens.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，发生了一件奇怪的事。

sentences.en: A little boy is standing next to him.
sentences.zh: 一个小男孩站在他身边。

sentences.en: The boy says, "Please draw me a sheep."
sentences.zh: 男孩说：请给我画一只羊。

sentences.en: The pilot cannot believe his eyes.
sentences.zh: 飞行员不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: The little boy comes from a very small planet.
sentences.zh: 小男孩来自一个非常小的星球。

sentences.en: His planet is not much bigger than a house.
sentences.zh: 他的星球比一所房子大不了多少。

sentences.en: On his planet, there are three small volcanoes.
sentences.zh: 他的星球上有三座小火山。

sentences.en: Every morning, he cleans the volcanoes.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，他打扫火山。

sentences.en: He also pulls out the bad plants.
sentences.zh: 他还会拔掉坏植物。

sentences.en: If he does not do this work, the plants grow too big.
sentences.zh: 如果不做这些事，植物会长得太大。

sentences.en: Then the planet is in danger.
sentences.zh: 那星球就危险了。

sentences.en: The little prince takes good care of his planet.
sentences.zh: 小王子把自己的星球照顾得很好。

sentences.en: He likes to watch the sun go down.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢看日落。

sentences.en: On his planet, he can see the sunset many times a day.
sentences.zh: 在他的星球上，他一天能看很多次日落。

sentences.en: He only needs to move his chair a little.
sentences.zh: 他只需要把椅子挪一点点。

sentences.en: His planet is small, but it is his home.
sentences.zh: 他的星球很小，但那是他的家。

sentences.en: One day, a flower grows on the little planet.
sentences.zh: 有一天，小星球上长出一朵花。

sentences.en: It is a rose.
sentences.zh: 那是一朵玫瑰花。

sentences.en: It is very beautiful, and it knows it.
sentences.zh: 它非常美丽，它自己也知道。

sentences.en: The rose is proud.
sentences.zh: 玫瑰花很骄傲。

sentences.en: It asks the little prince to water it every day.
sentences.zh: 它让小王子每天给它浇水。

sentences.en: It asks for a glass cover at night.
sentences.zh: 它让小王子晚上给它盖上玻璃罩。

sentences.en: The little prince takes good care of the rose.
sentences.zh: 小王子把玫瑰花照顾得很好。

sentences.en: But the rose is never happy.
sentences.zh: 但玫瑰花总是不开心。

sentences.en: It always wants more.
sentences.zh: 它总是想要更多。

sentences.en: The little prince feels tired and sad.
sentences.zh: 小王子感到累了，也难过了。

sentences.en: He decides to leave his planet.
sentences.zh: 他决定离开自己的星球。

sentences.en: He wants to see other places and learn new things.
sentences.zh: 他想去看看别的地方，学一些新东西。

sentences.en: The little prince visits the first planet.
sentences.zh: 小王子来到第一颗星球。

sentences.en: A king lives there.
sentences.zh: 一位国王住在那里。

sentences.en: The king wears a long red coat.
sentences.zh: 国王穿着一件长长的红袍。

sentences.en: He is the only person on his planet.
sentences.zh: 他是这个星球上唯一的人。

sentences.en: But he says he is the king of everything.
sentences.zh: 但他说他是一切的国王。

sentences.en: He gives orders all day.
sentences.zh: 他整天发号施令。

sentences.en: He orders the sun to go down in the evening.
sentences.zh: 他命令太阳在晚上落下。

sentences.en: He orders the stars to shine at night.
sentences.zh: 他命令星星在晚上发光。

sentences.en: The little prince is surprised.
sentences.zh: 小王子很惊讶。

sentences.en: The sun goes down in the evening anyway.
sentences.zh: 太阳本来晚上就会落下。

sentences.en: A good order is one that people can really do.
sentences.zh: 好的命令，是人们真的能做到的命令。

sentences.en: The little prince leaves the king and goes on.
sentences.zh: 小王子离开国王，继续前行。

sentences.en: On the second planet, there is a strange man.
sentences.zh: 第二颗星球上住着一个奇怪的人。

sentences.en: He wears a funny hat.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。

sentences.en: When people meet him, he takes off his hat.
sentences.zh: 有人来时，他就脱下帽子。

sentences.en: He wants people to clap for him.
sentences.zh: 他想让人们为他鼓掌。

sentences.en: He says, "I am the cleverest man in the world."
sentences.zh: 他说：我是世界上最聪明的人。

sentences.en: He says, "I am the most beautiful man, too."
sentences.zh: 他说：我也是最漂亮的人。

sentences.en: The little prince claps for him.
sentences.zh: 小王子为他鼓掌。

sentences.en: The man is very happy.
sentences.zh: 这个人非常高兴。

sentences.en: But the little prince does not understand him.
sentences.zh: 但小王子不理解他。

sentences.en: Why does he need other people to tell him he is good?
sentences.zh: 为什么他需要别人告诉他他很好？

sentences.en: The little prince leaves and thinks about it.
sentences.zh: 小王子离开了，一路想着这件事。

sentences.en: People who only want praise are very strange.
sentences.zh: 只想要赞美的人，真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: On the third planet, there is a man with many bottles.
sentences.zh: 第三颗星球上，有一个有很多瓶子的人。

sentences.en: The bottles are full of wine.
sentences.zh: 瓶子里装满了酒。

sentences.en: The little prince asks him, "What are you doing?"
sentences.zh: 小王子问他：你在做什么？

sentences.en: The man says, "I am drinking."
sentences.zh: 那人说：我在喝酒。

sentences.en: The little prince asks, "Why do you drink?"
sentences.zh: 小王子问：你为什么喝酒？

sentences.en: The man answers, "To forget."
sentences.zh: 那人回答：为了忘记。

sentences.en: "To forget what?" asks the little prince.
sentences.zh: 小王子问：忘记什么？

sentences.en: "To forget that I am sad," says the man.
sentences.zh: 那人说：忘记我很难过。

sentences.en: The little prince is very surprised.
sentences.zh: 小王子非常惊讶。

sentences.en: The man drinks because he is sad.
sentences.zh: 这个人因为难过才喝酒。

sentences.en: And drinking makes him sad again.
sentences.zh: 而喝酒又让他再次难过。

sentences.en: The little prince leaves, and feels sorry for the man.
sentences.zh: 小王子离开了，心里为这个人难过。

sentences.en: On the fourth planet, there is a very busy man.
sentences.zh: 第四颗星球上，有一个非常忙的人。

sentences.en: He is counting something all day.
sentences.zh: 他整天都在数东西。

sentences.en: He does not look up when the little prince comes.
sentences.zh: 小王子来了，他也不抬头。

sentences.en: The little prince asks, "What are you counting?"
sentences.zh: 小王子问：你在数什么？

sentences.en: The man says, "The stars. I own them all."
sentences.zh: 那人说：星星。我拥有所有的星星。

sentences.en: He counts the stars again and again.
sentences.zh: 他一遍又一遍地数星星。

sentences.en: He writes the number on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 他把数字写在一张纸上。

sentences.en: He puts the paper in a box.
sentences.zh: 他把纸放进一个盒子里。

sentences.en: The little prince says, "But you do nothing with the stars."
sentences.zh: 小王子说：可是你没有用星星做任何事。

sentences.en: The man does not answer. He is too busy.
sentences.zh: 那人不回答。他太忙了。

sentences.en: The little prince thinks: owning is not the same as loving.
sentences.zh: 小王子想：拥有和爱是不一样的。

sentences.en: He leaves the businessman behind.
sentences.zh: 他把商人抛在身后。

sentences.en: On the fifth planet, there is a lamplighter.
sentences.zh: 第五颗星球上，有一个点灯人。

sentences.en: His planet is the smallest of all.
sentences.zh: 他的星球是所有星球中最小的。

sentences.en: There is only one lamp and one lamplighter.
sentences.zh: 那里只有一盏灯和一个点灯人。

sentences.en: The planet turns very fast.
sentences.zh: 这颗星球转得非常快。

sentences.en: Every minute is a new day.
sentences.zh: 每一分钟就是新的一天。

sentences.en: Every minute, the lamplighter lights the lamp.
sentences.zh: 每分钟，点灯人就点亮灯。

sentences.en: Every minute, he puts the lamp out again.
sentences.zh: 每分钟，他又把灯熄灭。

sentences.en: He has no time to rest.
sentences.zh: 他没有时间休息。

sentences.en: He has no time to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他没有时间睡觉。

sentences.en: But he does his work well, every time.
sentences.zh: 但他每一次都把工作做好。

sentences.en: The little prince likes him.
sentences.zh: 小王子喜欢他。

sentences.en: His work is for other people, not only for himself.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是为了别人，不只是为了自己。

sentences.en: On the sixth planet, there is a geographer.
sentences.zh: 第六颗星球上，有一位地理学家。

sentences.en: He has many big books.
sentences.zh: 他有很多大书。

sentences.en: He writes about mountains and rivers.
sentences.zh: 他写山川和河流。

sentences.en: He writes about deserts and oceans.
sentences.zh: 他写沙漠和海洋。

sentences.en: But he never leaves his desk.
sentences.zh: 但他从不离开自己的桌子。

sentences.en: He has never seen a mountain.
sentences.zh: 他从没见过一座山。

sentences.en: He has never seen a river.
sentences.zh: 他从没见过一条河。

sentences.en: He only asks other people what they saw.
sentences.zh: 他只问别人看到了什么。

sentences.en: He tells the little prince, "Your flower will not last."
sentences.zh: 他告诉小王子：你的花不会长久。

sentences.en: Flowers do not live long, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，花活不长。

sentences.en: The little prince feels sad for the first time.
sentences.zh: 小王子第一次感到难过。

sentences.en: He thinks of his rose, alone on his small planet.
sentences.zh: 他想起自己的玫瑰花，独自在小小的星球上。

sentences.en: The little prince comes to the Earth.
sentences.zh: 小王子来到了地球。

sentences.en: In the desert, he meets a fox.
sentences.zh: 在沙漠里，他遇到一只狐狸。

sentences.en: The fox says, "Please make friends with me."
sentences.zh: 狐狸说：请和我做朋友。

sentences.en: The little prince asks, "What does that mean?"
sentences.zh: 小王子问：那是什么意思？

sentences.en: The fox says, "It means we need each other."
sentences.zh: 狐狸说：意思是我们彼此需要。

sentences.en: Every day, the little prince comes at the same time.
sentences.zh: 每天，小王子都在同一时间来。

sentences.en: The fox waits for him, and its heart beats fast.
sentences.zh: 狐狸等着他，心跳得很快。

sentences.en: They play together and talk together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起玩，一起聊天。

sentences.en: Slowly, they become friends.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，他们成了朋友。

sentences.en: Before he leaves, the fox tells him a secret.
sentences.zh: 临走前，狐狸告诉他一个秘密。

sentences.en: You can only see the really important things with your heart.
sentences.zh: 只有用心，才能看到真正重要的东西。

sentences.en: Your eyes cannot see them.
sentences.zh: 你的眼睛看不到它们。

sentences.en: The little prince walks in the desert.
sentences.zh: 小王子走在沙漠里。

sentences.en: He is thirsty, and so is the pilot.
sentences.zh: 他很渴，飞行员也很渴。

sentences.en: They walk for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们走了很久。

sentences.en: Then they find a well.
sentences.zh: 然后他们找到一口井。

sentences.en: The water in the well is sweet and cold.
sentences.zh: 井里的水又甜又凉。

sentences.en: They drink, and they feel happy.
sentences.zh: 他们喝了水，感到很高兴。

sentences.en: The little prince says, "People are thirsty for something more."
sentences.zh: 小王子说：人们渴望的东西比水更多。

sentences.en: At night, a yellow snake comes.
sentences.zh: 夜里，一条黄色的蛇来了。

sentences.en: The snake is dangerous, but the little prince is not afraid.
sentences.zh: 蛇很危险，但小王子不害怕。

sentences.en: The pilot is very worried.
sentences.zh: 飞行员非常担心。

sentences.en: The little prince says, "Do not be sad. I must go home."
sentences.zh: 小王子说：别难过。我必须回家了。

sentences.en: His home is far away, on his small planet.
sentences.zh: 他的家很远，在他的小小的星球上。

sentences.en: It is time for the little prince to go home.
sentences.zh: 小王子要回家了。

sentences.en: The pilot is very sad.
sentences.zh: 飞行员非常难过。

sentences.en: The little prince says, "Do not cry."
sentences.zh: 小王子说：别哭。

sentences.en: "When you look at the stars at night, think of me."
sentences.zh: 晚上你看星星的时候，就想想我。

sentences.en: "On one of the stars, I will be laughing."
sentences.zh: 在其中一颗星星上，我会笑着。

sentences.en: "Then all the stars will laugh with you."
sentences.zh: 然后所有的星星都会陪你一起笑。

sentences.en: The little prince walks away into the desert.
sentences.zh: 小王子走进沙漠，越走越远。

sentences.en: The pilot watches him until he cannot see him.
sentences.zh: 飞行员一直看着他，直到再也看不见。

sentences.en: The little prince's story ends, but the stars are still there.
sentences.zh: 小王子的故事结束了，但星星还在那里。

sentences.en: The pilot fixes his plane and flies home.
sentences.zh: 飞行员修好飞机，飞回了家。

sentences.en: But he never forgets the little prince.
sentences.zh: 但他永远忘不了小王子。

sentences.en: At night, he still looks at the stars.
sentences.zh: 夜里，他依然看着星星。

sentences.en: And sometimes, he thinks he can hear them laugh.
sentences.zh: 有时候，他觉得自己能听见星星在笑。
